root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from double cleanup of the `encrypt_pending` counter and scatterlist entries in the `-EBUSY` error path of `tls_do_encryption`, which corrupts the synchronization state and permits the TLS record to be freed while an asynchronous callback remains pending.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description notes that "the synchronous error path in tls_do_encryption() performs the same cleanup again, double-decrementing encrypt_pending," and the patch introduces a check `if (rc != -EINPROGRESS)` to skip the `atomic_dec(&ctx->encrypt_pending);` operation because the async callback "has already handled encrypt_pending and sge restoration."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix double resource cleanup in tls_do_encryption by skipping synchronous decrement when the async callback has already handled completion.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional check to delete the record and return early if tls_encrypt_async_wait returns a status other than -EINPROGRESS, including comments explaining that the async callback already handled resource cleanup.
intent_record.how: Prevents double decrementing of the encrypt_pending counter and ensures the record is removed from the list when asynchronous encryption completes or fails without remaining in progress.
